rules.accepted_credit_types: CE directly related to the APRN role or population focus; providers accepted: academic institutions, Nevada-numbered providers, providers approved by another state nursing or health-related board, or recognized bodies (AACN, AANA, ANCC, NAPNAP, NLN)
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep CE certificates at least 4 years and the bioterrorism certificate indefinitely.

topics.who: All APRNs: first within 2 years after initial licensure, then every 4 years
APRNs with authority to prescribe controlled substances (misuse and abuse of controlled substances, opioid prescribing or addiction, or SBIRT)
DEA-registered practitioners (initial DEA registration or renewal from June 2023)
Those who provide or supervise emergency medical services in a hospital or primary care; HIV stigma, discrimination and bias; within 2 years after starting such care (SB 439, 2023)

rules.notes: 45 hours in the APRN role/population focus may include the 30 hours required for the RN license (board table: APRN = additional 15 h per cycle). Board encourages (optional) CE on rare diseases/pediatric cancer and geriatrics.
